params.prompt: A photograph at a welder's eye level, standing at his workbench inside a small fabrication shop and looking straight out through the wide open roll-up bay door: the clean brushed-steel top of the bench fills the lower third of the frame, empty and flat, a welding helmet and a pair of gloves set at the far left edge; beyond the door, late golden-hour light, the rooftops of a small Pacific Northwest town across the fields and Mount Rainier rising huge and pink-lit behind it in a clear sky; the dark door frame and shop walls edge the view. Use the first attached image for the exact profile of Mount Rainier's north face. Photoreal, crisp, 35 mm, a slight warm flare from the door; the centre of the bench top is perfectly empty; no people, no text, no logos, no signs.
